entities.name: Bacterial ribosomal protein uS13
observations: The 121-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt uS13 B1XSS4; Swiss-Prot alignment identity and coverage are 100%.

uS13 is a 30S ribosomal subunit protein involved in rRNA contacts, intersubunit bridges, and A/P-site tRNA contacts; annotations include rRNA binding, tRNA binding, and structural constituent of ribosome.
Pfam Ribosomal_S13 (PF00416.28) detected at residues 3–108; sequence-derived mass 13,556.7 Da and pI 10.65.
